name: Velvethorn — Luxury Geneware Aesthetics Circle
description: Where Thornwork embraces horn and antler geneware as raw identity expression, Velvethorn operates in the rarefied upper tiers as a luxury aesthetics circle — members commission bespoke geneware modifications that blur the line between body and haute couture, favoring soft horn nubs covered in living velvet tissue, bioluminescent patterning that coordinates with seasonal fashion, and fur modifications in colors that don't exist in nature. Entry into core Velvethorn circles requires both the financial means for premium geneware (typically Φ40,000–Φ200,000 per modification) and an invitation from existing members. The subculture has its own internal designers — called 'Shapers' — who are as celebrated as any fashion house, and waiting lists for the most sought-after Shapers stretch years.
cultural_impact: Velvethorn has driven a measurable spike in premium geneware clinic revenue across M88's upper tiers and has begun to influence mainstream Tier 4 fashion aesthetics, with 'velvet horn' becoming a shorthand for aspirational luxury body modification even among those who can't afford Velvethorn-caliber work.
key_figures: The Velvet House (anonymous collective of senior Shapers)
story_hooks: A Velvethorn Shaper is found dead, their most recent client's commissioned modification incomplete — and the client, a Spire-level corporate executive, wants the work finished quietly, but the Shaper's notes suggest the modification was designed to do something the client didn't commission.

A Tier 2 geneware artist is producing Velvethorn-quality work at a fraction of the price, selling to clients the circle would never admit — Velvethorn's inner sanctum wants them discredited or absorbed, and the artist wants neither.

Lysander Mwangi-Beaumont is commissioning a modification so extreme it's never been attempted — something that will require the subject to spend six months in a medically induced suspension state — and three different parties want to know what he's becoming before he emerges.
